scope: Difficulty 0: 8 professions × 4 seeds = 32 runs; difficulty 3: 8 professions × 2 seeds = 16 runs; 48 v22 full-route runs total.
method: Paired seeds beta19-${profession}-${index}-d${difficulty}; same legal two-action lookahead, route/reward/shop/event policy and candidateFit heuristic as prior v22 audit. JSON roundtrip after each action; v22 acquisition gates and public-wrapper dispatch checked. Incoming totals use v22 engine metrics; maxAttackTurnTotal is raw damage across all hit packets in the single enemy turn. Actual net HP loss is observed as positive per-action HP deltas; v22 attackHpLost/petAbsorbed/burnHpLost are exact engine metric deltas. Pressure is measured from actual enemyPressure state each player turn.
limitations: Small deterministic-policy sample, not human-play balance evidence. Elite route nodes were not selected by this policy, so the three new elite encounters may have no coverage; counts are reported. Runs stop at a 600-action bound.
